newsitem.title: UK: Rank selling Rank Xerox stake for $1.6 billion to Xerox.
newsitem.headline: Rank selling Rank Xerox stake for $1.6 billion to Xerox.

text.p: British leisure company Rank Group Plc said Friday it would sell its remaining 20 percent stake in office equipment joint venture Rank Xerox to Xerox Corp. for as much as one billion pounds ($1.6 billion).
Rank said it had signed a letter of intent on the deal, which is subject to a definitive agreement.

Xerox will pay 500 million pounds ($812.6 million) on completion of the transaction, expected to take place at the end of June. The balance will be payable in two annual instalments of 220 million pounds ($358 million).
Xerox may pay another 60 million pounds ($98 million) in 2000, based on profit performance.
Rank also said it intended to repurchase its own shares up to a maximum value of 250 million pounds ($407 million).
Rank said it expected a share buyback later this year and would use the balance of the initial consideration to cut debt and invest in its leisure and entertainment businesses.
